item.description: PLYMOUTH, Mass. item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former DeSantis spokesperson's PR firm lands more than $700K in government contracts
item.description: State records show a former Governor DeSantis spokesperson’s private PR firm has secured more than $700K in state contracts since she left the public payroll.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 11,000 rescued in Nepal floods as desperate search for survivors continues
item.description: More than 11,000 people have been rescued after catastrophic floods struck the Nepal-China border — but thousands are still missing as the search for survivors continues.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Eat well! Do good! Columbia, Ulele and more celebrate September with tasty fundraiser
item.description: Eat well! Do good! Columbia Restaurant, Ulele and more celebrate September with tasty "Community Harvest" fundraiser. The 1905 Family of Restaurants is donating part of every bill to almost 100 nonprofits.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sarasota police asking for help to solve 9-year cold case
item.description: It’s been nine years since 14-year-old Jabez Spann was last seen in Sarasota and police detectives are asking the public for help.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fox News says Maria Bartiromo is no longer with company
item.description: Fox News Media says longtime host Maria Bartiromo is leaving the company after more than 12 years. No reason for the departure was announced.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] SEC sues LSU, alleging a coordinated push to recruit ex-pro athletes in defiance of rules
item.description: The Southeastern Conference has filed a federal lawsuit against LSU, accusing the school of recruiting professional athletes against league rules

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Intruder arrested after being accused of breaking into 93-year-old woman's Tampa apartment
item.description: A 93-year-old Tampa woman found a stranger standing at the foot of her bed Sunday morning after initially mistaking him for her grandson, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough schools expanding vaping detectors to middle, K-8 campuses
item.description: Hillsborough County Public Schools is expanding its use of vaping detectors to middle schools and K-8 campuses as the district works to prevent and more quickly respond to vaping on school grounds.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] North Port considers 18-month moratorium on data centers as details emerge for data center development site
item.description: North Port commissioners are considering an 18-month moratorium on data centers while a multi-building application remains under review, drawing strong public outcry over environmental risks.
